deviations: fit_predict caps eta on the evaluation rows at max(z_fit)+1 (ETA_HEADROOM) so exp() cannot overflow; needed because the 900-weight design fitted on 10% of the days predicts absurd values (R2 was -inf). It never binds on the normal fits.
noise_floor also returns a degrees-of-freedom adjusted value (0.935 vs raw 0.955) and a singleton row share; 30% of the 2636 cells hold one row.
Plots clip R2 at -0.2 (learning curve of the top design on 10% of days is about -19.7).
questions: Stand-in with back-transform 'duan' gives chrono 0.798 and seeded 0.905 (vs 0.858/0.911 for none/ls). p1 chose ls so p3 uses ls; chief may want to know duan is fragile under the chronological split.

Real run: target = C7_hr_x_time (seeded 0.9322) edges C6_fine_weather (about 0.9322) by under 1e-4; the argmax rule is a near tie. Chronological R2 of the target equals the anchor's within 0.001 (chrono_gain 0.0007) although day-block gain is 0.018, and the chrono-best level is C5 (0.893); the Expectation guessed the target in 250-450 weights (ok: 393) and the chronological split preferring a simpler model (it does).
